attributes.action: Introduce measures to deny abusive "Karen" behaviour
attributes.additional_details:
*DISCLAIMER - 'KARENS' DO NOT INCLUDE PEOPLE NAMED KAREN.*

OCCASIONALLY, KARENS CAN BE MALE, AND SHOULD ONLY BE SENTENCED FROM OFFENDANT
attributes.background: Karens - people who argue about the simple and/ little things (e.g. parking too close, buying the last item of a product, etc.) They also assume they own exclusive priorities and rights above the public
